question: Should wacli add `media backfill` as a core command with an opt-in timeout and default full-store backfill behavior?
rationale: The patch is now focused and no blocking code defect was found, but a new user-facing media command with long-running default behavior is a product and operations choice.

options.title: Accept the narrowed command
options.body: Land this focused backfill command as documented, relying on explicit user invocation plus `--limit`, `--workers`, and global `--timeout` for operational control.

options.title: Require bounded defaults
options.body: Ask for a default limit or timeout before merge if maintainers do not want full-store media downloads to be the default behavior.

options.title: Defer core command surface
options.body: Keep the media gap documented and defer a core backfill command until a broader media-completeness direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrowed command
recommendation.body: Land this focused backfill command as documented, relying on explicit user invocation plus `--limit`, `--workers`, and global `--timeout` for operational control.
